verified_sources.source_name: Kuwait Society of Engineers - Waterproofing & Thermal Insulation Codes
verified_sources.key_insights: Flash flood roof load dynamics in Kuwait: Ponding water due to clogged scuppers (المرازيم). Requirements for 100% solids elastomeric liquid waterproofing, minimum 1.5mm dry film thickness (DFT), and alkali-resistant polyester fleece reinforcement.

verified_sources.source_name: Kuwait Building Materials Mfg - JetaRoof Technical Data Sheet
verified_sources.key_insights: JetaRoof (عازل جيتاروف): High elongation (>400%) acrylic/polyurethane hybrid copolymer liquid membrane. UV reflection (white finish reducing roof slab temperature by 6-10°C). Tensile strength across building expansion joints.

Turnkey pricing in Kuwait for JetaRoof multi-coat system with woven fiberglass mesh (فايبر مش): 2.200 to 3.800 KWD/sqm including surface cleaning, crack injection, primer, mesh embedding, and 3 cross coats with 5-to-10 year warranty.
